label: Bible Study
prompt: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in _____ seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.
verse: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.
note: Naaman wanted a showy healing — he got told to take seven dips in the Jordan, and stormed off insulted.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: _____ are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
verse: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
note: After Thomas finally saw, Jesus blessed everyone who'd come after him — all who believe without seeing.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much _____?
verse: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?
note: Jonah ends with God's question about Nineveh's people — and 'also much cattle.' He cared about the animals too.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most _____ flame.
verse: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.
note: The Song's climax: love strong as death, jealousy cruel as the grave, its coals a blazing fire.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: My son, despise not the _____ of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:
verse: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:
note: Don't despise the LORD's 'chastening' — Hebrews 12:5–6 quotes this to show that discipline is proof of sonship.
